posts.author: FleshToDust
posts.body:
This is an RPG card battle game. You begin your journey going through various trials and must explore the game and get stronger as you do so. It will not be linear so there will be varying paths you can explore as you get stronger.
The card battle system is how you will engage in combat with foes. You will need to upgrade your deck over time with varying strategies.
The game is a non-linear Christian card combat RPG.
I will be posting more regular updates on my youtube channel.
Here is a devlog I made some time ago to give you an idea how the game works.
​

posts.author: rue669
posts.body:
Tried out the demo this week.
It's interesting and I like the concept. Definitely has the open world feel, which is great, and I rather like the GBA style black and white graphics.
I think the opening needs to be fleshed out a bit. No one in their right mind would just give someone a house to live in. I felt like there was some story that could be there that you just didn't spend the time to do. If you don't want story and just gameplay, that's cool; it'll just need to be restructured then (a lot of iphone games, for example, don't have stories but have quests and whatnot).
I'd make a save anywhere feature! Open world games all have this.
The number of quests is great. Lots of stuff to do and explore, and I think that's the point of the game. You've nailed that part. There's just other stuff that you might want to clean up or improve (or remove if it makes no sense for you to do).

posts.author: Parallax Panda
posts.body: Cool, looks much more interesting this way. How did you handle the animation?

posts.author: FleshToDust
posts.body:
I made 450 frames of animation adding new cards to each frame and altering the opacity.
The animation goes on for about 2 minutes and then loops again. It should seamlessly go on forever. 450 was a lot to do but it paid off I think.
This was done with a moghunter plugin by the way. I wasn't sure about loading the menu's with a script call so I just used his plugin. It's a nice plugin too. You can do splash screens, lots of funky stuff with the title screen and there's even a fullscreen toggle which is why it goes into fullscreen automatically on startup.
